punchline: Zynga spent $100 million on data centers of its own, then ended up closing them.
thirty_sec: There was this Australian startup, Shoes of Prey, where you designed your own shoes online. It did well, so it opened stores in malls around the world, took venture money and moved to the US. The stores sold less than projected, and in 2018 it collapsed after mass layoffs. Paul Jarvis uses it in Company of One to ask two things before growing: do you need it, and can you do it with what you have?
